core_obligations: Factor the morphism: write it as the composite of the graph into the fibre product and the second projection (proof lines 2051-2055)

Quasi-compactness of the graph: it is a section of the quasi-separated morphism given by the base change of the quasi-separated outer morphism, so the section statement applies (proof lines 2056-2059)
Quasi-compactness of the projection: it is the base change of the quasi-compact composite (proof lines 2060-2062)
proof_roadmap: 把 f 写成 (1,f): X → X ×_Z Y 与 pr_2 的复合。
(1,f) 是准分离态射 X ×_Z Y → X（g 的基变换）的截面 ⇒ 准紧。
pr_2 是 g∘f 的基变换 ⇒ 准紧；准紧的复合准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for morphisms of algebraic stacks with quasi-compact composite and quasi-separated outer morphism, the inner morphism is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2043-2049, label lemma-quasi-compact-permanence). The proof (source lines 2051-2065) factors the morphism through the fibre product, gets quasi-compactness of the graph from the section statement applied to the base change of the quasi-separated outer morphism, of the projection from base change permanence, and concludes by composition permanence (proof lines 2051-2064). The factorization and the two permanence steps are the content. H2.
